summary: The candidate independently fixes and tests the C2 pending-row transfer defect: legal ring size 2 is accepted, odd committed boundaries transfer exactly one endpoint-local row, and even boundaries transfer none. It is a valid partial correction, but it does not implement or validate the original issue's end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark contract. Recommendation is request_changes when judged against the original issue, not rejection of the narrow C2 correction.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original C2 defect: ring size 2 raises ValueError; N=101/ring=8 returns five rows; N=102/ring=8 returns six rows instead of one/zero. Imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang.
91 passed and 17 subtests passed; demonstrates the old suite did not catch the reproduced C2 contract failure.
93 passed and 17 subtests passed, including the candidate C2 odd/even, wraparound, unequal-ring and validation regression cases.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-dba4bbb14566/venv/bin/python inline exhaustive mapping and GPU row-copy probe (candidate 7d1a4b0)
tests.what_was_measured: 5,200 independent mappings across request slots, rings 2/4/8/16/32, lengths 0..259 had zero failures; invalid non-power-of-two rings were rejected. On AMD Instinct MI350X, copied the independently selected 4096-byte FP32 row from source index 6 (ring 2) to destination index 28 (ring 8), matched a CPU reference exactly, and left adjacent rows untouched.
Candidate report artifacts contain trailing whitespace/newline formatting errors; no runtime source whitespace error was reported.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2 on AMD Instinct MI350X executed the independent C2 row-copy numerical check. This validates row geometry/copy only, not DSpark execution.

native_rebuild_evidence: git diff --name-only found no changed C/C++/CUDA/HIP/header/Cython files. The candidate changes Python, documentation, tests and reports only, so no native rebuild was applicable. The loaded aiter native module was /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-dba4bbb14566/cache/aiter/module_aiter_core.so and was not evidence for the changed Python path.
remaining_counterexamples: No end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was run with Mooncake or NIXL.
Streaming and concurrent request behavior remain unverified.
Chunked prefill and prefix-cache restoration, including odd prefix hits and separation of H from N, remain unverified; decode radix cache remains explicitly incompatible with speculative decoding.
First draft/verify, partial and full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 reuse, and Engram-history updates remain unverified end to end.
Cancellation, stale-write prevention, transfer-before-execution/source-release ordering, and request-slot reuse remain unverified.
Generation parity against non-disaggregated DeepSeek-V4.1, actual speculative acceptance, and throughput remain unmeasured.
The prepared ROCm/HIP platform cannot execute DSpark because _handle_dspark accepts only device strings beginning with cuda or npu.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or real multi-process/cross-node Mooncake/NIXL topology were available.
remaining_limitations: The candidate is testable and verified only as a narrow C2 boundary-state correction. The host reports AMD Instinct MI350X, ROCm 7.2/HIP 7.2; DSpark's platform guard excludes HIP. The tiny Llama fixture was not substituted because it cannot qualify DeepSeek-V4.1 architecture, DSpark semantics, or distributed transport.
